text:
Ana: Quick sync — we need to lock launch criteria for 'Compact Observability' (beta). Goal: give PLG users a lightweight console surface for cost+errors+traces without full infra cost. Proposed acceptance:

Ana: - dashboard with per-route cost breakdown (last 7d), per-model error rate, top-5 slow endpoints
Ana: - tracing hook + sampled span links for 99p latency for top routes
Ana: - automated regression alerting on error spikes (configurable)
Ana: - shipped behind feature-flag + gradual rollouts to beta orgs

Ben: Question — per-route cost needs token attribution. Pre-aggregates ok or we do on-read? pre-agg preferred. Can we do hourly rollups? :thinking:

Karim: Hourly rollups fine. We'll add a lightweight pre-aggregate job that emits route/model cost keys. Accuracy ~1-2% acceptable for beta.

Sophia: Sampling: default 2% global sampling + spike mode (burst to 10% for error windows). Need to ensure KV cache doesn't blow up with full traces. Also require backpressure if storage queue backs up.

Leah: UI note — keep the cost widget compact: small table + sparkline per route. Expandable detail panel for traces/errors. Avoid new navigation entries for beta (embed into existing 'Usage' tab).

Ben: Engineering constraints: CPU for pre-agg + 10% storage delta for spans. Estimate: +2 cores on analytics pool for beta. Also we need a new tracing hook endpoint auth smoke test.

Ana: Launch gating proposal:
Ana: - Feature flag gating + opt-in for 10 beta orgs
Ana: - SLAs: dashboard render <1.5s for typical queries; trace sample retrieval <500ms for 95p
Ana: - No P0 known-blockers: if pre-agg job causes >5% ingestion lag it's a cutoff

Sophia: Agree on cutoffs. Also require an incident playbook stub in docs (who paged, rollback flag).

Karim: Data items to deliver: schema v1 for pre-agg, example SQL for rolling sums, and retention plan (30d hot, 365d cold).

Ben: I'll add a small feature-flagged endpoint and an ops metric: preagg_lag_seconds. Assigning myself to infra changes; ETA: 2 sprints.

Leah: I'll mock the compact cards by EOD Mon. Need real numbers for sparkline ranges.

Ana: Customer ask: AcmeHealth wants per-department cost split and immediate alerts on model errors. We can include department tag if instrumentation exists; otherwise this is a follow-up scope.

Ben: Department tag TBD — we can accept tags via header X-Redwood-Dept. Need SDK update for that. Defer if team bandwidth low.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: New staging deploy queued for branch observe/compact-beta at 2024-06-15T18:00Z

Ana: Next steps: Ben to PR infra doc + pre-agg schema by Wed, Karim to provide example queries, Leah to deliver mocks, Sophia to draft playbook. Sync Thurs 10am. :calendar:

Ben: ack. Will paste infra sketch in this thread.

Karim: ack — I'll attach sample query later.

Leah: ack — will drop Figma link.

Sophia: ack — will draft incident steps.

Ana: Thanks team :tada: Let's keep scope tight: defer span attribution and per-token billing for GA.
